title: SYMBIOTE: 4 Day Synergy Split
author: Coach Zylan
desc: This program will mostly pair muscle groups that work synergistically. The Four training days are Back + Hamstrings, Chest + Triceps, Quads + Calves, and Shoulders + Biceps. This split checks all the boxes, but leaves room for focusing certain muscle groups with more volume. The exercise selection focuses on basic movements that can effectively be progressed, while also allowing some variation where needed. With this program, you can spread the 4 workouts throughout each week if you need more recovery time (recommended for beginners) it can also be run 4 days on, 1 day off, on repeat; or it can even be run perpetually if you feel your recovery is up to par. If you choose either of the latter options just run the program twice in a row (and consider at least a week deload in between )

ex.note: Focus on form and back connection-save intensity for deadlifts.
Choose variation: dumbbell, deficit, barbell, RDL-just keep the bias towards hamstrings. Brace tightly, arch into the stretch, control eccentric always, do not over extend at top
Use whichever grip works for you. stick with the same setup only make changes if needed (joint pain/alignment etc) To achieve rep goal, use assisted if not strong enough, or do weighted if too strong
Make every rep high quality, Focus on alignment: opening chest, retracting shoulder blades, pushing through elbows on triceps. Avoid failure-think of it as more of a warm up for heavy pressing
Controlled eccentric as always, don’t bias chest or tris more- just align yourself for maximum strength
Same idea as bench-no bias towards chest or tri, just max effort/reps. To reach rep goal you can use assistance, or add weight.
Top set heaviest, latter sets higher volume, focus on form either way. Head up, core tight, knees forward, open hips. Can be subbed with any squat pattern if needed, just bring the same intensity
Experiment with setup for max quad recruitment: dumbbell, barbell, smith, front/back foot elevated etc. control eccentric more, can substitute for strict lunges, just measure weight the same way
If one or both calf machines are unavailable, barbell calf raise or leg press calf press always works. Just don’t neglect the calves.
Mostly a rotator cuff warm up and to open up chest/shoulders to allow more bicep recruitment
Can be done barbell, dumbbell, single arm, machine.
Achieve maximum stretch- control the lowering until arm is straight, but don’t bitch out on effort. Open up chest and shoulders to get more movement on bicep. Some Slight body English ok near failure
Can be done seated, standing, machine, cable or dumbbell. Just control form, focus side delts
Can be done barbell, dumbbell, cable. Can also be done bent over if you’d like to target more rear delts. Don’t be afraid of some trap recruitment when you approach failure
